points.qualification: narrow precedence to the PAYLOAD-DIGEST MATCH for admitted scope documents
points.basis: doc_digest(scope) runs above the row filter, before rows are counted. One ambiguous spec, five callers, THREE distinct answers: CONFIG.INVALID for canonicalisable documents, AdmissionError EXACT_JSON_TYPE_REQUIRED / STRING_KEY_REQUIRED for those that do not canonicalise. The first proposal's 'every caller of an ambiguous spec is told the same one thing' is false.

points.qualification: distinguish guard EXISTENCE from guard POSITION
points.basis: Existence is the whole soundness argument: with no guard, either candidate holder obtains a verified digest because the existential match succeeds for each separately. Position decides only which true reason a NON-candidate is given. independent20 NEW-SHOULD-1 reaches the same distinction independently; recorded as corroboration NOT re-derived here.

points.disagreementWithFirstProposal: It examined this docstring and left it, reasoning the sentence 'is about why the guard exists ... It is accurate.' Clause by clause that is right; as composed it is not. The 'because' binds the existential rationale to 'refused before any payload comparison', so a reader takes the ORDERING to be what prevents the verified digest - the exact misreading the new inline comment twelve lines below denies. Leaving it would leave one function documenting two incompatible rationales.
points.editMade: Minimal: the rationale now attaches to the refusal EXISTING; the placement is stated separately for what it decides. No new law; the CARDINALITY registry citation and both preserved refusals untouched.

points.qualification: AST/code comparison must separate intended docstring differences from executable behaviour
points.basis: A docstring IS a code-object constant, so the first proposal's 'identical compiled code objects' test would now fail for an intentional documentation change. work/compare-executable.py normalises docstrings to a sentinel, compares AST and code objects, and reports differing docstrings by qualified name as a separate result.
